unit_note: USD millions. Dots mark no transactions and (**) marks amounts below $500,000 in absolute value; both marks are omitted from the numeric cells. Pages 20-21 (United States Agency for Global Media through Nuclear Regulatory Commission). FCC Spectrum Auction Program Account prints (**) / dots across all three periods and is retained as a label-only row. October omits September's FDIC Office of Inspector General line, leaving Deposit Insurance Fund as the sole numeric Gross Outlays component and FSLIC Resolution Fund as the sole numeric Applicable Receipts component of Total--FDIC, while both lines sum into Total--FDIC net outlays (columns 3, 6, 9 at tol=1).
